evidence: The electronic and optical properties of NTO deposited by ALD were investigated by preparing a series of films of varying niobium content. Ellipsometry measurements indicated that the tin oxide and niobium oxide homodeposition rates were 1.28 Å/cycle and 0.74 Å/cycle, respectively. The films were characterized by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and X-ray diffraction (XRD) after calcination to 500 °C to crystallize the tin oxide. SEM of the smooth TiO2 scaffold (Figure 3a) indicated nominal particle size of ∼150 nm. After crystallization, the rough NTO surface (Figure 3b) was clearly visible by SEM through the entire thickness of the scaffold film (Figure 3c). SEM of freshly cleaved surfaces also led to an estimated NTO thickness of 8 ± 3 nm after 2 deposition supercycles.
